create.name: Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery
create.bio:
Abhayagiri is a Theravada forest monastery in the hills of Mendocino County, northern California, belonging to the Thai Forest lineage of Ajahn Chah. Ajahn Pasanno and Ajahn Amaro led it together as co-abbots from 1996; Ajahn Amaro later left to head Amaravati in England, and after Ajahn Pasanno stepped back he stayed on as guiding elder, with Ajahn Nyaniko now serving as abbot. Monks, novices, postulants and lay residents keep a simple daily round of chanting, meditation, shared work and a single meal, and the community lives on what visitors freely give.

Guests may come for the day or ask to stay overnight, and on Saturday evenings the community holds chanting, meditation and a Dhamma talk that anyone can attend. The YouTube channel, started in 2016, is busy: it carries those Saturday talks, shorter reflections from the senior monks, readings from the forest tradition and recordings of ceremonies. The website keeps a large free archive of talks, written reflections and books given away for free distribution.

free_resources.title: Free-distribution books
